paragraphs: The useful bridge is a preparation hypothesis joined to context-specific predictions and an independent modern performance comparison. Universal historical recipes, technology transfer and lifecycle superiority remain outside the evidence established here.

A new return can change one of those conclusions without rewriting the others: additional archaeological contexts test prevalence, controlled material tests assess performance, and a complete inventory assesses cost and emissions.

studies.label: Perth assemblies: replace assumptions with declared data
studies.summary: WA product data, module-preserving EPD transcriptions, pack rounding and an incomplete-assembly comparison ledger.
studies.conclusion: Published product data now constrain quantities, material-only prices and selected LCA contributions. Complete assembly totals and rankings remain unresolved until missing inventories and equivalent performance are established.

steps.title: Constraint: compare complete services on the same house
paragraphs: Use the existing 180 m² house geometry and net external wall area. The masonry cases use one or two equivalent utility-brick leaves for quantity arithmetic. They are not an approved external facade or a claim that utility brick replaces every facing product. The cladding case represents one declared 6 mm sheet layer.

The structural frame, insulation, linings, coatings, ties, openings, services and performance evidence remain separate. A common floor area does not make these incomplete assemblies functionally equivalent.

steps.title: Measurement: retain declared units, modules and PCR versions
steps.output: Product-declared LCA values with a comparison boundary
paragraphs: The WA clay-products EPD reports a production average per tonne; the fibre-cement declaration uses an installed product square metre over its reference life. GWP-total values are retained by lifecycle module. They are modelled product declarations, not new field emissions measurements.

PCR versions, datasets, allocation and module coverage differ. Undeclared modules stay missing. Module D remains separate, and GWP-total is not silently exchanged with GWP-GHG. This transcription does not license a cross-product whole-wall ranking.

steps.title: Inference: scale product quantities and round an actual pack case
steps.output: A product-only benchmark with order and installed bases separated
paragraphs: Coverage and approximate unit-mass bounds come from the current manufacturer table. The calculation distinguishes installed equivalent units, chosen order allowance, whole-unit rounding, pack rounding and surplus. Surplus is not automatically waste sent to landfill.

Use the directly opened, dated pack price including GST and excluding cartage; the earlier search snippet showed a different price. The brick EPD average is a proxy for this unit. Sheet production contribution is calculated on its own product-area basis. Neither subtotal includes every wall material or installed cost.

steps.title: Reduction: thermal resistance needs a wall model
paragraphs: The official guidance gives approximate uninsulated brick-veneer and weatherboard R-values. Adding a chosen R2.5 layer in series illustrates ideal path conductance; it is not a tested result for the candidate assemblies.

Framing and junctions introduce parallel heat paths. Gaps, compression, moisture, orientation, mass and transient conditions affect whole-building performance. A one-dimensional steady heat-flow example cannot establish NatHERS compliance or annual operational savings.

steps.title: Inference: retain missing costs and lifecycle terms as unknown
steps.output: An incomplete-assembly ledger that withholds a winner
paragraphs: The benchmark records show known product contributions, missing items and performance requirements. Whole-assembly cost and whole-life GWP remain null. They cannot be calculated by replacing the missing frame, insulation, labour, transport and maintenance terms with zero.

Request matched assembly specifications and current scope-identical quotations before choosing a cost winner. For emissions, reconcile PCR, indicators, service life, quantities, delivery, installation, use, replacement and end of life. Keep any beyond-boundary benefit separate.

steps.title: Disposition: advance from product data to an equivalent assembly
steps.output: A specific next evidence return for Perth
paragraphs: This extension replaces several assigned inputs with traceable published values while retaining their uncertainty and basis. The remaining return is concrete: complete layer and connection inventories, tested performance, installation productivity, delivered quotes and compatible lifecycle scenarios.

Ancient mortar insights can suggest a modern test. Selection of a residential system depends on that system’s own evidence, local supply and whole-project consequences. No supplier was contacted and no purchase, certification or new material test was performed.
